blind.description: A terracotta-red statue of a horned demon or devil seated on a throne upon a square tiered plinth. The figure has curved ram-like horns, a goatee, folded bat wings, muscular humanoid torso, a loincloth, and cloven hooves, with hands resting on its knees in a brooding pose. The surfaces are smooth, continuous, and solid with stylized sculpted details, colored in reddish-brown clay tones with tan horns, beard, and hooves.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a winged seated figure atop a square pedestal, showing two folded wings flanking the shoulders, the top of the hunched back, and two horns curving outward from the forward-leaning head.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 80% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 4.5 to 5 feet tall) and about twice as wide at the base.
